task_title: starlark-dsl guide matches shipped DSL: signatures, marshalling, json() encoder + drift guard
task_criteria: PROOF: go test -short -count=1 -run TestDslGuideBuiltinDrift ./internal/builtin/ passes at the integrated tip, and docs/guides/starlark-dsl.md contains the exact signatures http_get(url, headers=None) and json(value) plus a committed runnable example script demo/scripts/dsl-builtins.star making the three documented calls. FAILIF: the drift test is absent from internal/builtin/, or it passes while the guide omits any builtin signature that dsl run --help prints, or the guide names a builtin the binary does not ship.

items.criterion: PROOF: go test -short -count=1 -run TestDslGuideBuiltinDrift ./internal/builtin/ passes at the integrated tip, and docs/guides/starlark-dsl.md contains the exact signatures http_get(url, headers=None) and json(value) plus a committed runnable example script demo/scripts/dsl-builtins.star making the three documented calls. FAILIF: the drift test is absent from internal/builtin/, or it passes while the guide omits any builtin signature that dsl run --help prints, or the guide names a builtin the binary does not ship.
items.detail: (1) Test run fresh: `go test -short -count=1 -run TestDslGuideBuiltinDrift ./internal/builtin/` exit_code=0, output 'ok github.com/wojons/muster/internal/builtin 0.078s'; whole package also green (`go test -short -count=1 ./internal/builtin/` -> 'ok ... 12.998s'). (2) Drift test present and committed: internal/builtin/dsl_docs_drift_test.go (TestDslGuideBuiltinDrift) + fixture internal/builtin/testdata/starlark-dsl-prefix.md, both in `git ls-files`. (3) Guide signatures exact: docs/guides/starlark-dsl.md:72-76 list http_get(url, headers=None) -> (status, body) / http_post(url, body=None, headers=None) / http_put(url, body=None, headers=None) / http_delete(url, headers=None) / json(value) -> string — verified verbatim against live `go run ./cmd/openapi-cli dsl run --help` (exit 0), which prints exactly these five lines; no help-printed signature is missing from the guide. (4) No phantom builtins: full grep of the 651-line guide shows only the five shipped names in call positions (http_get/post/put/delete, json()); json.loads/json.dumps appear only under 'What Is NOT Provided' and the interpreter ships no json attribute (dsl.go jsonBuiltin has no attributes). (5) Example script committed (git ls-files) and makes the three documented calls (demo/scripts/dsl-builtins.star lines 27, 32-33, 37); executed live via `go run ./cmd/openapi-cli dsl run demo/scripts/dsl-builtins.star` against a stub on port 9801: printed 'dict body -> status 201', 'json() encoded body -> status 201', 'headers dict -> status 200', EXIT=0.

items.criterion: Drift guard is non-vacuous: it demonstrably fails on drifted docs, not just passes on the fixed guide
items.detail: dsl_docs_drift_test.go lines ~157-183 re-run dslGuideDriftErrors against the committed pre-fix fixture testdata/starlark-dsl-prefix.md and t.Fatalf unless it yields a 'missing the shipped builtin signature' finding; the passing run (exit 0, ok 0.078s) proves those bite assertions executed and held. Manual read of the fixture confirms it lacks all '-> (status, body)' signature lines and json(value), so real drift exists for the guard to catch.

items.criterion: The example script's documented workflow is genuinely runnable end-to-end (prerequisites + expected output documented and matching)
items.detail: docs/guides/starlark-dsl.md:299-319 documents exact prerequisites (python3 demo/services/task-forge/server.py 9801, seed.py 9801 — both files exist in-tree per ls) and the expected output block; my live execution with a stub server on 9801 produced exactly the documented three lines (dict 201 / json() 201 / headers 200) with EXIT=0. Flask is not installed in this environment so the real server.py could not be started, but the script's own prerequisite comments match the doc and the call shapes/paths are exercised.

items.criterion: Guide factual claims match the dsl.go implementation (no doc/behavior contradictions in signatures, marshalling, Content-Type, return shape)
items.detail: Spot-checked against internal/builtin/dsl.go: body only on post/put (UnpackArgs: get/delete take url+headers? only, lines ~250/317); Content-Type default set first then headers override (comments 'Default first, then caller headers'); return is (int, TrimSpace(str)) tuple in all four helpers; str body verbatim (bodyBytesFromValue), large ints exact via json.Number, NaN/Inf rejected (starlarkToGoValue math.IsNaN/IsInf), non-2xx not an error. Command reference (single form, --verbose/-V only, no dsl test/--spec/--var/--timeout) matches cobra def (dsl.go:24-70, ExactArgs(2), single BoolVarP) and the live --help output.

items.criterion: The documented dsl command is reachable from the CLI entrypoint (not orphaned code)
items.detail: internal/builtin/root.go:119 `root.AddCommand(newDslCommand())` wires it in; proven by real binary runs in this session: `go run ./cmd/openapi-cli dsl run --help` (exit 0, printed the five signatures + -V flag) and `go run ./cmd/openapi-cli dsl run demo/scripts/dsl-builtins.star` (exit 0, three status lines).
